content.comment_body: Good evening, I have the usual issue. Does anyone have a solution? Thanks.
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. Please note this is an English-speaking forum; kindly write your future posts in English. Thank you. Could you clarify what the exact problem is?

Hi [user_name], sorry for my English (I'm not fluent). Here's my issue: I created a project with [product_name] [version_no] (three total pages). I set up a navigator and connected it with links to the pages. After uploading the project to an SD card, I log in but can only see the home page. When I use the navigator to access the linked pages, I receive an 'ERROR 404: the target is not found' message. Thank you in advance for any help.

Please upload your [product_name] project as a ZIP file. We need to review the project to provide further assistance. Additionally, [product_name] [version_no] is outdated. I recommend upgrading to the current version.
Sorry, the version is [version_no]. Here is the project.
Your program appears to be damaged.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is experiencing a '404 - target not found' error while navigating between linked pages in a project built with [product_name], after uploading it to an SD card and accessing it via navigator. The thread surfaces issues with navigation reliability and possible project corruption, as well as the need for clear error feedback and integrity checking in [product_name].
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects smooth navigation between all project pages through the navigator without errors, and anticipates receiving straightforward troubleshooting advice and dependable functionality from the project editor.
